title: Huge unidentified underwater craft prompt US–UK–Soviet defense contacts
place_text: Pacific Ocean, Baltic Sea, North Sea, Atlantic Ocean

tellings.quote: very large unidentified underwater craft were discovered and cited in the Pacific Ocean.

plain: Very large unidentified underwater craft were spotted in the Pacific, Atlantic, Baltic and North Sea, and this pushed American, British and Soviet defense people to talk to each other, according to the president of a Russian republic. He tells Michels that "very large unidentified underwater craft were discovered" in the Pacific. If true, the mystery was serious enough to bring Cold War rivals together.
